title: Unit 26 Consolidation: The Press, Truth and Responsibility
goal: I can use the words for fact-checking, manipulation, rebuttal and press ethics.
I can say how sure a report is, describe a text with a participle, refute a claim and state a duty of the press.
I can grade a person's conduct with a degree adverb and say what the text about Márai Sándor tells.
